column1: # Phase 4: the port write-ups into docs/, then prototypes/ untracked (tools/reorg/run_all.sh).
# prototypes/ is git-ignored already; 326 files were force-added over time. They stay on disk
# (git rm --cached); only the seven ANALYSIS.md write-ups are documentation and move.
# Columns are TAB-separated. Every tracked */ANALYSIS.md must be classified (the `check` line).
# The folder is the CART tag (what build.zig, the channel list and docs/ports/ call the screen),
# not the RE folder's name: 1988_re is the c64_1988 cart. tos4x_re is not a port but the study of
# Atari's TOS 2-4 sources (GEM 5's reference): it goes with the OS docs.
# No stubs: prototypes/ is not in the repository any more, so nothing outside could link there.
# The convention itself, as the st-port / c64-port skills and the docs spell it
